plugin.name: aaron-marketing
plugin.description: 120 marketing skills and 8 commands as an AI marketing staff — one plugin, portable skills on 70+ hosts, or an 8-bot team — and as a four-layer operating system: Narrative strategy; SEO/GEO, Organic Social, Email, Paid Ads, and Influencer channels; Product Launch orchestration; and a Protocol layer with seven append-only truth registries plus non-canonical working memory. Eight typed advisory frameworks (TALE, CORE-EEAT, CITE, STAR, ECHO, SEND, ROAS, RAMP) use machine-checkable auditor artifacts and immutable standalone runtime contracts. Keyless-first and zero-dependency.

github_about.comment: SSOT for the GitHub repo About (sidebar description + topics). NOT read by GitHub directly — projected onto the repo by scripts/sync-about.sh (owner-run, --live), verified weekly by .github/workflows/about-drift.yml, and its leading skill count is checked against the tree by scripts/check-versions.sh. Edit here when the skill/discipline/gate counts change; the description MUST start with the current skill count so check-versions can parse it.
github_about.description: 120 marketing skills as an AI marketing staff — plugin, portable skills, or an 8-bot team across 7 disciplines (narrative, SEO/GEO, social, email, paid, influencer, launch) on one contract, with 8 auditor gates: TALE · CORE-EEAT · CITE · ECHO · SEND · ROAS · STAR · RAMP.

groupings.title: Brand Narrative · TALE (16) — trace → architect → land → evaluate
groupings.description: L1 strategy: trace positioning truth, architect the message/voice/story canon, land it across surfaces, then evaluate separate truth, system, and effectiveness profiles. narrative-quality-auditor never averages those unlike constructs.

groupings.title: SEO/GEO · SITE · CORE-EEAT+CITE (16) — survey → implement → tune → evaluate
groupings.description: Search and generative-engine optimization: keyword/SERP/gap research, content and citation readiness, markup/page plays, CORE-EEAT and CITE auditor gates, then rank, performance, and off-site monitoring.

groupings.title: Social · ECHO (16) — explore → craft → host → observe
groupings.description: Organic social: channel/voice discovery, platform-native planning and creative, inbox/crisis operations, then listening and measurement. social-quality-auditor runs one asset-gate or program-maturity profile per unit, never a mixed composite.

groupings.title: Email · SEND (16) — setup → engage → nurture → deliver
groupings.description: Email across promotional, retention, cold-outbound, and newsletter profiles: sender/list setup, creative/rendering, lifecycle journeys, the email-quality-auditor gate, experiments, and provider-level placement monitoring.

groupings.title: Paid ads · ROAS (16) — research → orchestrate → activate → scale
groupings.description: Paid media across direct-response, prospecting, and incremental-profit profiles: structure/audiences/queries/feed, creative/tests/bids/landing, the ad-account-auditor gate, then attribution, pacing, fatigue, and causal readback.

groupings.title: Influencer marketing · STAR (16) — scout → target → activate → report
groupings.description: Creator campaigns end to end: audience and creator discovery, planning/briefs/budgets, outreach and the STAR content gate, contracts/amplification, then post-click, ROI, and reporting evidence.

groupings.title: Launch · RAMP (16) — research → assemble → mobilize → prove
groupings.description: Product launch orchestration: positioning/tier/window/access, assets/pricing/enablement, then separate preflight, execution, and outcome profiles around launch operations, monitoring, feedback, retro, and momentum.

groupings.title: Protocol layer (8) — shared truth registries & memory
groupings.description: Seven sole-writer registries backed by append-only event streams and rebuildable projections, plus non-canonical HOT/WARM/COLD working memory. Other skills propose; registry owners authorize canonical mutations.

The release asset
`aaron-marketing-skills-{bundle_version}-agent-plugin-v1-lite.tar.gz` is a generated,
static Skills package. It contains the 120 strict `SKILL.md` projections and
only their reachable static references. It does **not** contain commands, hooks,
connector helpers, controllers, scoring/state runtimes, other executable
repository scripts, or `mcp.json`. Installing it therefore registers no MCP
server, starts no process, makes no network request, writes no persistent state,
and grants no credential, tool, mutation, or execution authority. Any client
tool use still requires that client's separate configuration and the user's
request-specific authorization. See the exact [Portable Lite package and
capability boundary](docs/agent-plugins-v1.md).
